bundled.note: mermaid.min.js inlines these, so an OSV query on mermaid does not see them. OSV lists five advisories for DOMPurify 3.4.12 (its IN_PLACE, SAFE_FOR_TEMPLATES and XHTML-parser paths; fixed by 3.4.17) and one for KaTeX 0.16.47 (a prototype-pollution precondition; fixed in 0.18.2). No Mermaid release bundles a fixed DOMPurify yet: 12.2.0 still inlines 3.4.12. It does inline KaTeX 0.18.11, which is past the KaTeX fix. Whether Mermaid reaches those paths is not assessed here.
